slides.title: Number of the Week
slides.body: The Nasdaq fell 5.5% on Thursday, Nov 5, to 24,315, entering a correction. It was the worst day for the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow since April 2025, and AI and chip stocks led the fall.

slides.title: Thursday's Selloff
slides.subtitle: Nov 5 moves (percent)
slides.body: On Wednesday, the Dow had gained about 3% after Democrats won Congress. Thursday erased that rally.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Oil fell 8.3% on Wednesday on Iran-deal hopes, then steadied near $90 (WTI). Trump blamed Democrats for Thursday's drop, while analysts cited AI spending doubts.
